title: Avila Beach Whale Watching
specs: Small boat with only 6 passengers for unobstructed views and personal interaction
Daily sightings of whales, dolphins, sea lions, sea otters, harbor seals, and sea birds
Weight limit 300 lbs per person; larger guests may book two seats and must discuss boarding options
Children under 13 must wear life jackets for entire trip
Private/custom tours and ash scattering services available by calling
includes: Use of life jackets (required for children under 13)
gap: Exact trip duration not explicitly stated
blurb: Guests join a small group of up to 6 passengers on a 28 ft power catamaran for whale watching and wildlife viewing in San Luis Bay. Tours offer close views of whales, dolphins, sea lions, and other marine life with expert naturalist captains. The boat is stable and fast, allowing quick movement to wildlife sightings and a comfortable ride.
extraNote: No booking fees added at checkout · Trips cancelled for rain, dense fog, or very windy rough conditions with full refund · Departure dock at Harford Landing on a historic pier at Port San Luis near Avila Beach, CA · April through November
